title: Figure 4.10: Growth Rate of Spherically Converging/Diverging Ion-Beam Instability
description: Scatter plot of normalized growth rate (-0.1 to 0.4) versus β on a logarithmic axis (10^-4 to 10^0), with parameters α=10^2, ζ=10^-1, κ=0.0 annotated. Open-circle data points connected by a dashed line rise with increasing β. Caption: 'Plot of Growth Rate of Spherically Converging/Diverging Ion-Beam Instability for the Variation of the Angular Velocity Spread'.
